source.quote: Non-GAAP operating expenses for the third quarter were $88.7 million dollars, up slightly from last quarter, and within our guidance range, despite headwinds from the continued strengthening of the New Israeli Shekel, net of hedging.
Non-GAAP gross margin this quarter was up significantly to 23.3% compared to 18.8% in Q3, just above the high end of our guidance.
Year to date, capital expenditure was approximately $25 million, and we now expect full-year capital expenditure in the range of approximately $45 million-$55 million.
